representation_evidence.locator: Entire board, especially the five numbered sections from “1 · Detect & page” through “5 · Resolve & learn”
representation_evidence.observation: The board presents a compact incident-response process in five stages, supporting the lightweight-process portion, but it does not identify the operational team as a SaaS team.

verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The core operational and failure/recovery flow is comprehensively covered: alert ingestion and deduplication, primary/secondary paging, acknowledgment and triage, incident declaration, parallel owner/on-call responsibilities, same-signal verification, failed-verification retry, and resolution-to-learning follow-through.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: R1 is only partial because the board represents a compact incident-response process but never states that it is specifically for a SaaS team.
verdict.coverage_summary: All 20 system-defining requirements are represented, including the five-minute secondary escalation and failed-verification mitigation loop. The only incomplete item is the supporting SaaS-team scope qualifier in R1, so the board is nearly complete but not a perfect visual acceptance record of every stated qualifier.
